subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw define a session-owned multi-turn model lease contract for `/model --turns N`, and should that contract share semantics with one-turn Gateway/chat model overrides?
rationale: The request adds public command syntax, config shape, persisted session state, provider/auth routing, warning timing, and fallback interaction; automation should not choose those semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Specify a unified lease contract
options.body: Define the temporary model lease state and counting rules first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway fields against that single contract.

options.title: Settle one-turn override first
options.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100876 settle request-local override semantics before multi-turn leases are added.

options.title: Decline native leases
options.body: Do not add native turn leases and instead document manual `/model default`, allowlists, or operational policy as the supported cost-governance path.

recommendation.title: Specify a unified lease contract
recommendation.body: Define the temporary model lease state and counting rules first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway fields against that single contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is on the existing session model override, auth-profile preservation, Gateway patch, and docs paths that would own the lease contract.
